steps.label: Ranking of the first half
steps.text: Each line is one district. Its firms are split at random, here half A counts.
steps.claim: All districts in the order of the first half.

steps.label: The ten top districts
steps.text: In half A the first ten districts sit at {{h06-slope.top_a}} times the average, interval {{h06-slope.top_a.range}}.
steps.claim: The ten top districts sit at about double.

steps.label: The same ten in half B
steps.text: The same ten districts sit at {{h06-slope.top_b}} times in half B, interval {{h06-slope.top_b.range}}. The chance band stays put.
steps.claim: Half B puts the same ten at the average.
